Court of Justice of the European Union

Summary

The case examines the principle of proportionality in EU administrative law.

Grounds

1. The principle of proportionality is a general principle of EU law.

2. The Court must examine whether the measure is appropriate and necessary.

3. In the present case, the measure goes beyond what is necessary to achieve the stated objective.

Operative part

The contested decision is annulled on grounds of disproportionality.
